claim_limit: Development and confirmation validation only; no live or shadow claim.

unchanged_cost_contract.entry_cost: raw entry multiplied by one plus bps
unchanged_cost_contract.exit_cost: raw exit multiplied by one minus bps
unchanged_cost_contract.planned_risk: cost-adjusted entry minus cost-adjusted planned stop

unchanged_execution_contract.entry_order_type_model: marketable limit filled at observed open plus adverse cost
unchanged_execution_contract.missing_data_behavior: preserve denominator as missed entry; no source, symbol, date, or event substitution

unchanged_exit_contract.intraday_stop_fill: planned stop when observed low reaches stop
unchanged_exit_contract.stop_gap_fill: worse of planned stop and observed session open
unchanged_exit_contract.stop_price: raw entry open minus frozen stop distance
